newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Olsen appoints new ministry in South Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Olsen appoints new ministry in South Australia.

text.p: South Australian premier John Olsen on Thursday announced his ministerial team, saying he had included all business and economic development functions in a new State development porfolio under his control.
The new ministry includes former premier Dean Brown, dumped last month by his Liberal Party colleagues, who will head information and contract services, industrial relations and Aboriginal affairs.
"Just like a league football team in the final part of the season I needed to make some adjustments but the timing is not right to make wholesale changes," Olsen said in a statement.
The Liberal government, which won a landslide victory in the 1993 poll following the collapse of the State Bank of South Australia, must face an election by December 1997.

Treasurer Stephen Baker, who was also under pressure from the backbenchers who deserted Brown, has retained his position, but has lost the finance and mines portfolios to Dale Baker who had previously been dumped from the ministry by Brown.
One new minister was appointed, Dorothy Kotz, who will head the employment, training and further education, youth affairs and correctional services portfolios.
